snippet.title: Playtest continues! Discover expreince WWI on your phone
snippet.description:
Playtest: 04/02/2026 – 18/02/2026 | 14 DAYS!
📝 How to participate:
1️⃣ Apply here: 👉https://forms.gle/WAWEKKwju8Sws2oP8
2️⃣ On February 4, 11:00 AM (UTC), the download link will become available for installation.
3️⃣ Please wait for approval — once approved, the download link will become active.

🔗 Download link: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.bixteam.weltkrieg1firestorm
⚠️ If you see “Item Not Found”, the link will become active soon. Please wait.

📱 Currently, only Android players can join.
🌍 Players from all countries are welcome!

🔥OUR DISCORD:   / discord  
The playtest runs for 14 full days and includes two game modes:
⚔️ Team Deathmatch 6x6
🏰 Ultimate Conquest 10x10

World War I multiplayer gameplay on mobile — recorded during the ongoing playtest of WELTKRIEG 1: FIRESTORM.
This video shows real online matches captured directly from a work-in-progress build of the game. You’ll see frontline combat, team-based action, and how WWI battles currently feel on mobile devices.

WELTKRIEG 1: FIRESTORM is a World War I mobile multiplayer shooter focused on atmosphere, teamwork, and large-scale online combat. The game is actively developed, and playtests like this help us improve balance, performance, and overall gameplay quality.
At this stage, we’re testing:
Online multiplayer stability
Weapon handling and combat flow
Match pacing and core mechanics
Mobile optimization
Thanks for watching and supporting the project — your feedback helps shape the future of the game.
#game #battle #fps #mobile #playtest #mobilegaming #gameplay #shootergames #field
